doc.title: Joe Darensbourg and Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1957-04-18

title: From Lafayette north to St. Louis; first meeting Charlie Creath and Fate Marable
summary: The show's first stop was Lafayette, then north through Gary and St. Louis, where he first met Charlie Creath and Fate Marable.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: we started... The first time we played after Hopeloos was Lafayette, Louisiana. That's where, uh, Haddock Hall originated, too. LeBlanc, you know, made Haddock Hall there.

And then, then we went on up north. We played all around the big town. St. Louis. And when I got to St. Louis on the medicine show, that's the first time that I run into, uh, Charlie Crest and Faith Merrill. Uh-huh.
Well, Faith Merrill was, was he playing on the boat? That's right.
Faith was, Faith was mostly playing on the boat, and Charlie Crest had the, this, uh, plantation. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. Market Street there.
